central_inscription_policy: Only the requested central inscription is transcribed. Clipped neighbouring text is not silently completed. B019 requests the lower complete line. B035 and B036 give the central numerals with visible adjacent punctuation.

notes.observation: The final cancelled token after the abbreviated element word is not recovered; cancellation merges it with the rule.

Several cancelled lines overlap. The upper quantified fragment and the lower Posons statement remain separate source layers. The extra upper X/relation and the word after Y are doubtful. The definition abbreviation sits above the equivalence arrow.

The replacement element minimal and dans sit above the cancelled plus petit element phrase. The upper tilde-Y display is live replacement ink. The parenthetical dotted-chevron notation overlaps the cancelled implication; the extreme-right condition and its short continuation below remain doubtful.
The crossing zigzag relation is reproduced by vector strokes without assigning a semantic operator name. Plain double chevrons and circle-above double chevrons remain distinct.
The axiom numeral has dense 5-like and 6-like superposed strokes. Both possible correction orders are recorded rather than claiming chronology from the darkened ink.
One long curve ends in an upper-right arrowhead. A separate unpointed curve loops round the lower label. Their approximate full source paths are reproduced in TikZ.
The terminal strokes in laisser/laisse and remplacer/remplace are compressed. Infinitive endings are preferred from the visible hooks, with alternatives retained.
The cancelled parenthetical label looks Af, with 4f retained as an alternative. The neutral box kind does not determine the reading.
V. and 5 are clear. The intervening abbreviated mark is p-like; an independent dot after it is not securely isolated.
The short word after prenons has an a-like body and a separate high stroke; a/un remain physically ambiguous.
The compressed word after parties could be fermees or finies. The above-line Phi de t.f. is separate inserted ink. Its curved leader is not silently made an opening parenthesis around de M.

The cancelled fermees is followed by obscured short ink. A descending stroke belongs to the inserted que above and cannot confidently be assigned to a deleted p. The remainder is left illegible instead of expanded.
The operator name appears Nucleons, but its central low strokes are compressed and no accent is confidently isolated. The cancelled sign before Omb has crossed/looped ink compatible with X or Phi.
A separate point below and to the left of the final M is reproduced as a free dot, without assigning multiplication or punctuation semantics.
The first word of the second line is compressed; voir and renvoi remain alternatives. The prop 32 group is underlined. The initial large curve is read as an opening parenthesis before cf.
The abbreviation after par has a visible high point over its middle portion. mic. is preferred, with nuc. retained; no expansion is supplied.
The numeral reads 5. Retracing alone does not establish a separately cancelled 6.
